content.comment_body: Hello, I'm searching for a function block in [product_name] that allows time comparison. For example, I have delay timer A and would like additional logic to activate an output if the time value is less than or greater than time A. This is urgent, so I'm posting here first since I couldn't quickly find similar examples in the forum or application resources. I'll keep looking for samples until I get a reply. Thank you in advance.

Timer values rely on the timer's timebase. For example: Time value: 2 minutes and 30 seconds has a timebase of seconds, resulting in 150 seconds. Time value: 4 hours and 39 minutes has a timebase of minutes, resulting in 279 minutes. Understanding these conversions is essential for comparing timer values with setpoints. Use an analog comparator for this purpose.
